content:
Priya: Quick sync 30bout staged rollout for routing-tier v2. Need a clear tenant cohort plan + overload protection before we flip any traffic.
Ben: Recap of ask: reduce avg token cost by switching heavy tenants to v2q6 while keeping SLA. We'll do phased rollout by tenant cohorts + region.
Chloe: Naming proposal: rf:<service>:<region>:<variant> e.g. rf=infr-distro:us-central1:v2q6. keep maxlength 64 chars.
Marcus: Cohorts: deterministic hash on tenant-id -> buckets. Suggested sizes: 0.5% smoke, 5% small, 25% ramp, 100% cutover. Smoke window 2h, small 8h, ramp 24h.
Priya: Add an emergency circuit-breaker: if region token error-rate >0.5% absolute OR cost-per-request increases by >12% with quality delta >3pt, rollback.
Ben: For quality delta we will use production eval set + human-sampled scoring. threshold: weighted_quality_drop >= 3% triggers soft-degrade (route to v2q4) otherwise hard rollback.
Chloe: Per-region capacity gate: if GPU mem pressure > 80% or avg queue latency > 120ms then pause ramps and redirect new sessions to regional fallback cluster. CanaryBot: noted: capacity gate monitors gpu_mem_pct and queue_ms metrics.
Marcus: Enterprise opt-ins: allow explicit opt-in flag rf:infr-distro:customer:<tenant-id>:canary. Opt-ins bypass percentage bucket but must pass smoke window and quality checks. Non-enterprise tenants blocked by default.
Priya: A/B plan: pick 10% of ramp cohort for A side (v2q6) vs B (v2q8) to measure cost vs latency vs quality. Keep AB for minimum 72h and export per-tenant metrics.
Ben: Observability checklist: dashboard tiles for p50/p95 latency, token/RPS, error-rate, model-quality, cost-per-request, cohort tag. Alerts: page on hard rollback, create ticket on soft-degrade.
Chloe: Runbook snippets:
  - soft-degrade: CanaryBot flips routing to fallback variant, notify #oncall, wait 30m, re-evaluate.
  - hard-rollback: full rollback to prior variant, create incident, notify CS for impacted customers.
Priya: Flag lifecycle: flags created -> staged -> active -> cleanup_candidate after 60 days -> auto-archive 30 days later unless 'retain' tag. Keep a migration map so infra teams can remove routing rules.
Marcus: Determinism: use tenant-id + rollout-seed for hashing so cohort membership stable across restarts. document seed per-release.
Ben: Scale-safety: if global RPS spike > 3x baseline sustained 5m, degrade all canary cohorts to fallback until spike subsides + notify SRE.
Chloe: Data export: ensure cohort tag attached to all telemetry and logs. we need daily job to compute cohort-level quality/cost tradeoffs.
Priya: Launch plan: deploy flag keys tomorrow, staging smoke Fri 10:00 UTC, prod start us-central1 2026-04-10 08:00 UTC with 0.5% smoke.
Marcus: Action items: Priya -> open FF tickets and set rollout-seed. Ben -> create AB experiment config + cost dashboard. Chloe -> add runbook steps + dashboard panels.
CanaryBot: scheduled: staging-smoke 2026-04-03T10:00:00Z, prod-smoke 2026-04-10T08:00:00Z. I will post status updates to this thread.
Priya: OK locking plan unless someone objects to 0.5% smoke window or 2h smoke duration. speak now or I'll file as approved.
Ben: fine by me.
Chloe: approved.
Marcus: approved.
Priya: thanks all. we'll iterate on thresholds after staging results.
